purpose: Submit an indent and verify its identifier, timestamp, audit entry, stock check, and notification.
preconditions: An authenticated employee is authorized to create an indent; required item, quantity, estimated cost, and justification are available.
action_or_input: Enter the required indent details and submit.
expected_result: The system stores the indent as Submitted with a unique ID, submission timestamp, audit entry, submitted version, initiated stock check, and submission notification.

purpose: Verify submission is blocked when mandatory indent information is missing.
preconditions: An authenticated employee is authorized to create an indent.
action_or_input: Submit an indent with one or more mandatory fields missing.
expected_result: Submission is blocked, missing information is identified, and no indent is submitted.

purpose: Verify a likely duplicate is flagged for Department Admin review.
preconditions: An authenticated employee is authorized to create an indent; a likely duplicate exists.
action_or_input: Submit an indent that the system detects as a potential duplicate.
expected_result: The indent is traceably flagged for Department Admin review; it is not automatically merged or cancelled.

purpose: Verify the requestor is informed when system stock records show the requested item.
preconditions: An authenticated employee is authorized to create an indent; system stock records show the requested item.
action_or_input: Submit an indent for the item present in system stock records.
expected_result: The requestor is informed that the item is present in system stock records, and the indent may proceed toward internal fulfilment.

purpose: Confirm an accepted delivery receipt and verify downstream eligibility information.
preconditions: The relevant indent, issue, or PO is active; delivery has been recorded; no unresolved discrepancy applies.
action_or_input: Open the delivery record, verify the goods, and record receipt confirmation.
expected_result: The confirmation is timestamped and audited; final stock posting is permitted as applicable; relevant stakeholders are notified and Accounts can access the confirmation for payment eligibility checks.

purpose: Verify partial receipt confirmation leaves the remaining quantity open.
preconditions: An active delivery record exists for a quantity greater than the accepted portion.
action_or_input: Confirm receipt of only the accepted portion.
expected_result: The accepted portion is confirmed and the remaining quantity stays open.

purpose: Verify discrepant goods are routed to discrepancy reporting instead of final acceptance.
preconditions: An active delivery record contains damage, shortage, a wrong item, or another discrepancy.
action_or_input: Record the discrepancy through PSM-UC-020 instead of confirming the discrepant portion as finally accepted.
expected_result: The discrepancy is recorded through PSM-UC-020 and the discrepant portion is not finally accepted.

purpose: View the current status and authorized history of an indent.
preconditions: The indent exists and the employee is authorized to view it.
action_or_input: Select the indent from My Requests or search for it.
expected_result: The system displays the lifecycle state, available key milestones, authorized history, visible hold or discrepancy status, and major generated lifecycle notifications where available; no business state changes.

purpose: Verify role-restricted information is omitted from procurement status.
preconditions: The employee can view the indent but some information is restricted by role.
action_or_input: Open the indent status and history.
expected_result: Restricted information is omitted from the displayed status and history.

purpose: Verify active reminders, escalations, or discrepancies are reflected without unauthorized disclosure.
preconditions: An authorized employee can view the indent; an SLA reminder, escalation, or discrepancy is active.
action_or_input: Open the indent status.
expected_result: The current status reflects the active reminder, escalation, or discrepancy without exposing unauthorized information.

purpose: Withdraw or cancel a pending indent in a state where policy permits the action.
preconditions: The employee owns or is authorized to act on an existing indent in a permissible state.
action_or_input: Select Withdraw or Cancel, then confirm the action.
expected_result: The indent enters the applicable withdrawn or cancelled state; the action is audited and relevant stakeholders are notified.

purpose: Verify withdrawal or cancellation is blocked in a non-permissible state.
preconditions: The employee is authorized to view an existing indent whose current state is not permissible for withdrawal or cancellation.
action_or_input: Select Withdraw or Cancel.
expected_result: The action is blocked and the indent remains unchanged.

purpose: Check stock and reserve sufficient allocable quantity for internal issue.
preconditions: An indent exists and stock records are available; allocable departmental or central stock is sufficient.
action_or_input: Department Admin opens the indent stock view, reviews availability and reservations, and reserves the required quantity.
expected_result: The system displays stock and reservations, records the reservation, updates allocable availability, and marks insufficient-stock cases for external procurement progression when applicable.

purpose: Verify a partial stock availability result is recorded without assuming split fulfilment.
preconditions: An indent exists and only part of its requested quantity is allocable.
action_or_input: Department Admin checks stock availability for the indent.
expected_result: The partial stock result is recorded; no split-fulfilment behavior beyond the specification is applied.

purpose: Verify the stock check remains pending when stock records are unavailable.
preconditions: An indent exists; stock records are unavailable.
action_or_input: Department Admin attempts to check stock availability.
expected_result: The check cannot be completed and the indent remains pending review.

purpose: Record and post an authorized stock adjustment with its audit entry.
preconditions: Department Admin is authorized; a consistent source event and stock item/location exist; no unresolved discrepancy blocks posting.
action_or_input: Select the stock item, location, and source event; enter the authorized adjustment and reason or reference.
expected_result: The system validates role and source-event consistency, posts the adjustment, and records an audit entry.

purpose: Verify an adjustment linked to an unresolved discrepancy is not finally posted.
preconditions: The proposed stock adjustment is linked to an unresolved discrepancy.
action_or_input: Attempt to record and post the adjustment.
expected_result: Final posting is blocked.

purpose: Verify an unauthorized stock adjustment is blocked.
preconditions: The actor lacks authorization to record the stock adjustment.
action_or_input: Attempt to record and post the adjustment.
expected_result: The adjustment is blocked.

purpose: Schedule picking and dispatch or collection readiness for an approved internal issue.
preconditions: An approved internal issue exists with a reserved quantity.
action_or_input: Department Admin opens the issue, schedules picking, and records dispatch or readiness for collection.
expected_result: The issue state is updated, the reservation is retained until the applicable receipt or posting point, the action is logged, and the requestor is alerted.

purpose: Verify an internal issue cannot proceed when verified inventory correction makes reserved stock unavailable.
preconditions: An approved internal issue exists; verified inventory correction shows reserved stock is no longer allocable.
action_or_input: Attempt to proceed with the internal issue.
expected_result: The issue cannot proceed and the indent returns to stock or procurement review.

purpose: Generate, review, optionally export, and log an operational, procurement, or stock report.
preconditions: The user is authorized for the selected report and its data.
action_or_input: Select an operational, procurement, or stock report; supply supported filters; generate and review it; optionally export it.
expected_result: The report is generated and its generation event is logged.

purpose: Verify access to a restricted report or data set is denied.
preconditions: The user lacks access to the selected report or data set.
action_or_input: Attempt to access the report or data set.
expected_result: Access is denied.

purpose: Review an indent, record priority where relevant, and route it for the applicable next step.
preconditions: An indent is available for Department Admin review.
action_or_input: Review its duplicate flag and stock result, record criticality or priority where relevant, and approve it for internal issue or the next configured approval or recommendation step.
expected_result: The indent is routed under the applicable workflow and the decision is recorded.

purpose: Verify Department Admin can reject an indent only with a justification.
preconditions: An indent is available for Department Admin review.
action_or_input: Reject the indent and provide a rejection justification.
expected_result: The rejection is recorded with the mandatory justification.

purpose: Verify a potential duplicate is reviewed rather than automatically cancelled.
preconditions: An indent flagged as a potential duplicate is available for Department Admin review.
action_or_input: Review the flagged indent.
expected_result: The duplicate is presented for review and the indent is not automatically cancelled.

purpose: Complete final review, approve procurement, and route it to Procurement & Stores Admin.
preconditions: An indent is routed to Director or Registrar for final review with audit and recommendation information.
action_or_input: Review the indent and approve it.
expected_result: The approved procurement is routed to Procurement & Stores Admin for tender or PO execution; the decision is recorded and applicable notifications are sent.

purpose: Verify a final rejection requires justification and enters Rejected state.
preconditions: An indent is routed to Director or Registrar for final review.
action_or_input: Reject the indent and provide a justification.
expected_result: The rejection is recorded with mandatory justification and the indent enters Rejected state.

purpose: Verify a matching invoice against its PO and GRN.
preconditions: The invoice, linked PO, and GRN are available; required quantities, amounts, receipt status, and vendor verification match.
action_or_input: Accounts Admin opens the invoice and linked PO/GRN, performs three-way matching, and records verification.
expected_result: The invoice is verified, the eligible portion is determined for partial receipt or invoice as applicable, and invoice status and verification action are recorded.

purpose: Verify a PO, GRN, and invoice mismatch places the invoice on hold.
preconditions: The invoice, linked PO, and GRN contain a mismatch.
action_or_input: Accounts Admin attempts three-way matching.
expected_result: The invoice is placed on hold.

purpose: Verify an invoice with invalid vendor verification cannot proceed to payment.
preconditions: The invoice is linked to a vendor whose verification is not valid.
action_or_input: Attempt to proceed with the invoice toward payment.
expected_result: The invoice cannot proceed to payment.

purpose: Review authorized procurement and financial records and generate or export an audit output.
preconditions: The auditor is authorized for the selected audit scope.
action_or_input: Select the audit scope, retrieve and review its relevant records, and generate or export the authorized audit output.
expected_result: Relevant records and audit history are available; the authorized audit access or report is logged.

purpose: Verify unauthorized data is excluded from audit scope.
preconditions: The auditor's authorized scope excludes some records or data.
action_or_input: Retrieve records and generate the audit output for the authorized scope.
expected_result: Unauthorized data is excluded.

purpose: Generate, optionally export, and log a financial report.
preconditions: Accounts Admin is authorized to access the selected financial report and data.
action_or_input: Select a financial report type, supply supported filters, generate and review it, and optionally export it.
expected_result: The report is generated from available procurement and payment data, and the generation event is logged.

purpose: Verify unauthorized financial report or data access is blocked.
preconditions: Accounts Admin is not authorized for the selected report or data.
action_or_input: Attempt to access the report or data.
expected_result: Access is blocked.

purpose: Review and recommend an indent for the next configured approval or procurement step.
preconditions: An indent is available to the Department Head for review.
action_or_input: Review the indent, stock information, necessity, priority, and budget considerations; record a recommendation.
expected_result: The indent is routed according to the configured approval path; the recommendation is recorded and applicable notifications are sent.

purpose: Verify a recommendation for changes returns the indent to the employee for modification.
preconditions: An indent is available to the Department Head for review.
action_or_input: Recommend changes to the employee.
expected_result: The indent returns to the employee for modification through PSM-UC-023.

purpose: Verify Department Head rejection requires justification.
preconditions: An indent is available to the Department Head for review.
action_or_input: Reject the indent and provide a justification.
expected_result: The rejection is recorded with the mandatory justification.

purpose: View authorized stock availability and reservations during Department Head review.
preconditions: An indent is available for Department Head review and stock information is available.
action_or_input: Open the stock view for the indent and use the displayed information in the review or recommendation.
expected_result: Authorized departmental and central availability and reservations are displayed for the review.

purpose: Verify unavailable stock information is not treated as a current stock result.
preconditions: An indent is available for Department Head review; stock information is unavailable.
action_or_input: Open the stock view for the indent.
expected_result: The review cannot rely on a current stock result.

purpose: Create or update a vendor record and record its verification status and history.
preconditions: Procurement & Stores Admin is authorized to manage vendor master data.
action_or_input: Create or open a vendor record; enter required vendor information, GST and bank details, and compliance documents; complete verification.
expected_result: The system validates required information, records the vendor as verified/eligible or unverified/ineligible as applicable, and retains version history and an audit record.

purpose: Verify incomplete or invalid vendor information leaves the vendor unverified and ineligible.
preconditions: Procurement & Stores Admin is authorized to manage vendor data.
action_or_input: Submit vendor details with required verification information incomplete or invalid.
expected_result: The vendor remains unverified and cannot be used for PO issuance or payment.

purpose: Verify vendor master updates preserve traceable prior versions.
preconditions: An existing vendor record has a stored version.
action_or_input: Update the vendor record.
expected_result: The previous vendor-master version remains traceable.

purpose: Record a goods discrepancy, request an applicable resolution, and gate final posting or payment.
preconditions: An authorized receiving actor can access a delivered goods record with a discrepancy.
action_or_input: Record discrepancy details and available evidence, link the case to the receipt/indent/PO, select an applicable requested resolution, and submit.
expected_result: A discrepancy case is created or updated; Procurement & Stores Admin is notified; Accounts can see the unresolved discrepancy so final posting or payment remains gated.

purpose: Verify accepted and discrepant portions remain separately traceable.
preconditions: Only part of a receipt is discrepant.
action_or_input: Record the discrepancy for the affected portion.
expected_result: Accepted and discrepant portions remain separately traceable.

purpose: Verify an immediately resolved issue returns to the accepted receipt path.
preconditions: A discrepancy has been identified and can be resolved immediately as accepted.
action_or_input: Resolve the issue immediately as accepted.
expected_result: The receipt can return to the accepted receipt path.

purpose: Create an inter-department transfer request and route an allocable request for source processing.
preconditions: Requesting Department Admin is authorized; source and destination locations and requested quantities are available.
action_or_input: Create the transfer request with source, destination, and quantities.
expected_result: The request is recorded, source availability is checked, an allocable request is prepared for source processing and reservation, and the relevant source party is notified.

purpose: Verify a transfer request cannot proceed for unavailable source quantity.
preconditions: Requested transfer quantity exceeds sufficient allocable source stock.
action_or_input: Submit the transfer request.
expected_result: The request cannot proceed for the unavailable quantity.

purpose: Publish a tender, record bids, evaluate them, and record committee selection.
preconditions: A tender procurement is ready; the defined scope, criteria, and timeline are available.
action_or_input: Publish the tender invitation, record submitted bids, have the Procurement Committee evaluate them against the defined criteria, and record its approval or selection.
expected_result: Tender decision and supporting records are retained, and the selected vendor is available for PO creation subject to vendor verification.

purpose: Verify a tender without an approved selection remains unresolved.
preconditions: A tender has not resulted in an approved selection.
action_or_input: Complete tender evaluation without recording an approved selection.
expected_result: The tender remains unresolved or requires a new tender action according to policy; no automatic retender occurs.

purpose: Modify an eligible pending indent while preserving version history and rerouting it for review.
preconditions: The employee is authorized to modify an indent in a modifiable state.
action_or_input: Edit the indent, satisfy mandatory validation, submit the modified version, and allow duplicate checking.
expected_result: The prior version is retained; the new version is created and logged; the indent is routed through the applicable review path.

purpose: Verify editing is blocked when the indent state is not modifiable.
preconditions: The employee can access an indent whose state is not modifiable.
action_or_input: Attempt to edit the indent.
expected_result: Editing is blocked and the prior active version and state remain intact.

purpose: Verify a modified version that fails validation is not resubmitted.
preconditions: The employee is authorized to modify an indent in a modifiable state.
action_or_input: Edit the indent with information that fails mandatory validation and attempt to resubmit.
expected_result: The modified version is not resubmitted and the prior active version and state remain intact.

purpose: Repeat a previous indent into a distinct editable draft and submit it as a new indent.
preconditions: The employee can access the previous indent and is authorized to create an indent.
action_or_input: Select the previous indent, create a draft from reusable data, change required details, and submit through PSM-UC-001.
expected_result: A new draft is created; on submission it receives its own ID and audit history; the previous indent remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify repeat or reorder is unavailable for an inaccessible prior indent.
preconditions: The prior indent is not accessible to the employee.
action_or_input: Attempt to repeat or reorder the prior indent.
expected_result: Repeat or reorder is unavailable; the previous indent remains unchanged and no new indent is created.

purpose: Record the procurement method and route an externally sourced indent for approval or execution.
preconditions: Stock is insufficient; prior required department review has occurred; procurement is ready for PS Admin review.
action_or_input: Review the indent, stock result, approval history, and value; record the method determined under the configured rules; route for final review if required.
expected_result: The procurement-method decision and supporting record are saved; the indent is routed for required final review or proceeds to direct PO creation or tender management as applicable.

purpose: Verify procurement execution is blocked when required prior approval is missing.
preconditions: An externally routed indent is missing a required prior approval.
action_or_input: Attempt procurement execution.
expected_result: Procurement execution is blocked.

purpose: Verify an unverified selected vendor must complete onboarding or verification before PO issuance.
preconditions: Procurement is ready for execution but the selected vendor is not verified.
action_or_input: Attempt to proceed toward PO issuance with the selected vendor.
expected_result: Vendor onboarding or verification is required before PO issuance.

purpose: Create and issue a PO linked to an approved indent and verified vendor.
preconditions: Required approvals are complete; a vendor is selected and verified.
action_or_input: Open the approved procurement, create a PO linked to its indent and vendor, and issue it.
expected_result: The system records the PO status and audit history; the PO is issued and centrally tracked.

purpose: Verify PO creation or issuance is blocked when required approval is missing.
preconditions: The procurement is missing a required approval.
action_or_input: Attempt to create or issue a PO.
expected_result: PO creation or issuance is blocked.

purpose: Verify PO issuance is blocked when vendor verification is incomplete.
preconditions: Required approvals are complete; vendor verification is incomplete.
action_or_input: Attempt to issue the PO.
expected_result: PO issuance is blocked.

purpose: View and update an authorized PO status or delivery schedule.
preconditions: A PO exists; PS Admin is authorized to update it.
action_or_input: Open the PO and record an authorized status or schedule update that includes a dispatch or delivery status event.
expected_result: The current status and schedule are displayed; the update is timestamped and audited; relevant stakeholders are alerted for the dispatch or delivery event.

purpose: Verify an unauthorized user cannot update PO status or schedule.
preconditions: A PO exists; the user lacks authorization to update it.
action_or_input: Attempt to update the PO status or delivery schedule.
expected_result: The update is blocked and the PO remains unchanged.

purpose: Inspect delivered goods and record an accepted receipt in a GRN.
preconditions: A relevant issue or PO exists; the receiving actor is authorized; the delivered goods are accepted.
action_or_input: Open the delivery record, inspect the goods, and record quantities and condition.
expected_result: The system creates or updates the GRN, marks accepted quantities accepted subject to required delivery confirmation, records the inspection, and notifies relevant stakeholders.

purpose: Verify partial receipt records accepted quantity and leaves the outstanding quantity open.
preconditions: A relevant issue or PO exists; only part of the ordered or issued quantity is received.
action_or_input: Inspect the delivery and record the partial accepted quantity.
expected_result: The GRN records the accepted received quantity and leaves the outstanding quantity open.

purpose: Verify rejected, damaged, or mismatched goods are recorded and routed to discrepancy handling.
preconditions: A relevant issue or PO exists; delivered goods are rejected, damaged, or mismatched.
action_or_input: Inspect and record the affected goods.
expected_result: The GRN records the rejection or discrepancy and invokes PSM-UC-020.

purpose: Process an eligible vendor payment and record its status and alert.
preconditions: An invoice record exists; Accounts Admin is authorized; required PO, accepted receipt, confirmation, invoice, vendor, and hold conditions permit payment.
action_or_input: Open the invoice/payment record, evaluate the required conditions, and record processing or release for an eligible full or partial amount.
expected_result: Payment status and audit history are recorded and the applicable payment-status alert is sent.

purpose: Verify payment remains on hold when a required condition is not satisfied.
preconditions: An invoice/payment record exists; at least one required payment condition is unsatisfied.
action_or_input: Attempt payment processing.
expected_result: Payment remains or becomes On Hold with a recorded reason.

purpose: Verify unresolved invoice mismatch prevents payment release.
preconditions: An invoice/payment record exists with an unresolved mismatch.
action_or_input: Attempt to release payment.
expected_result: Payment release is prevented.

purpose: Verify an unverified vendor cannot receive payment.
preconditions: An invoice/payment record exists; the vendor is unverified.
action_or_input: Attempt to release payment.
expected_result: Payment release is prevented.

purpose: View P&S dashboard metrics and permitted records within the user's authorized scope.
preconditions: The user is authenticated and has dashboard access.
action_or_input: Open the P&S dashboard and navigate to a permitted detailed record.
expected_result: The system identifies the authorized dashboard scope and displays current status and key metrics within it; no business state changes.

purpose: Verify restricted dashboard data is omitted.
preconditions: The user's dashboard scope excludes some data.
action_or_input: Open the P&S dashboard.
expected_result: Restricted data is omitted.

purpose: Create and activate an authorized scheduled-report definition.
preconditions: The user is authorized for the selected report and scheduling function.
action_or_input: Select a report and supported filters, define the schedule using available parameters, and save it.
expected_result: The scheduled-report definition is saved and the system confirms the schedule is active.

purpose: Verify an unauthorized report schedule is not created.
preconditions: The user is unauthorized for the selected report or scheduling function.
action_or_input: Attempt to schedule the report.
expected_result: No schedule is created and no future execution is established from the failed request.

purpose: Resolve a return, replacement, or warranty case with traceable communication and adjustments.
preconditions: An open discrepancy case exists; Procurement & Stores Admin is authorized to resolve it.
action_or_input: Review the evidence, record vendor communication and the authorized resolution, record any return or replacement progression, apply required inventory and accounting adjustments, and close when resolved.
expected_result: Resolution history and required adjustments are recorded, and the case is closed when resolved.

purpose: Verify replacement delivery is inspected before the case is treated as fully resolved.
preconditions: An open case has a replacement delivery.
action_or_input: Attempt to treat the case as fully resolved without completing replacement inspection and GRN recording through PSM-UC-028.
expected_result: The replacement must be inspected and recorded through PSM-UC-028 before the case can be treated as fully resolved.

purpose: Verify applicable invoice or payment hold remains while resolution is pending.
preconditions: A discrepancy case remains unresolved and an invoice or payment hold applies.
action_or_input: Leave the case resolution pending and inspect the related invoice/payment status.
expected_result: The applicable invoice or payment hold remains effective.

purpose: Reserve and dispatch an available inter-departmental stock transfer.
preconditions: A transfer request exists; source stock is available and allocable; source user is authorized.
action_or_input: Review the request and availability, reserve the approved quantity, and record dispatch.
expected_result: The transfer is dispatched and its state updated; the destination is notified.

purpose: Verify unavailable source quantity cannot be dispatched.
preconditions: A transfer request exists but source stock is insufficient for the requested quantity.
action_or_input: Attempt to dispatch the unavailable quantity.
expected_result: The unavailable quantity cannot be dispatched and the transfer remains unfulfilled for that quantity.

purpose: Confirm a dispatched transfer and complete both stock-ledger postings.
preconditions: A transfer is in Dispatched state.
action_or_input: Destination Department Admin opens the transfer and confirms receipt.
expected_result: The transfer is completed, source and destination ledgers are updated, and a completion audit entry is recorded.

purpose: Verify an unconfirmed transfer receipt leaves the transfer open without completed ledger posting.
preconditions: A transfer is in Dispatched state; receipt cannot be confirmed.
action_or_input: Attempt to confirm receipt without being able to confirm it.
expected_result: The transfer remains open and completed ledger posting is not performed.

purpose: Generate an authorized scheduled report when its schedule becomes due and log the generation.
preconditions: An active authorized report schedule exists; the report definition and permitted filters are valid.
action_or_input: Allow the configured report-generation schedule to become due.
expected_result: The system validates the active authorized schedule and report definition, generates the report using permitted criteria, records the generation event, and makes the report available through the authorized reporting mechanism.

purpose: Verify a disabled or no-longer-authorized schedule does not generate a report.
preconditions: A scheduled report is disabled or is no longer authorized.
action_or_input: Allow the configured schedule to become due.
expected_result: No report is generated and the failed or blocked attempt is auditable.

purpose: Verify report generation failure is logged without recording a successful generation.
preconditions: An active authorized report schedule becomes due, but report generation fails.
action_or_input: Run the scheduled report generation.
expected_result: No successful generation is recorded; the failure is logged for authorized follow-up.
